summary: Vitalik 发布博客《Digital minimalism》，讲他如何有意识地使用数字技术，比如不离开 X 平台，但改用 Firefly 多端客户端发帖。LambdaClass 发布 Lean Ethereum 共识客户端 ethlambda v1.0.0，与 10 月 29 日 Gattaca 发布的 Silver 一起，一周出现两个新共识客户端。EIP-8141 修正交易 nonce 检查边界。Binance 事件余波中，SEAL 讲述应急响应如何在几分钟内协调。

items.title: EIP-8141：交易 nonce 检查边界
items.note: 合并（raxhvl），破坏性修正：发送方 nonce 只接受到 `MAX-1`，因为检查必须给本交易的 nonce 自增留出空间，与 bogota 执行规范一致；实现方需要复查边界检查。
items.note_en: Was merged (raxhvl). In this breaking fix, the sender nonce is accepted only up to `MAX-1`, because the check must leave room for the nonce increment of this transaction, matching the bogota execution specs; implementers need to review their boundary checks.

items.title: ERC-8481：代理签名前风险报告
items.note: 20:56（TOLL），当天 34 帖。AI 代理在没人逐笔阅读的情况下准备并签名交易，而损失大多并不罕见、签名前就能看出：无限额授权给普通钱包或一周大的合约、转给首尾字符相同的仿冒地址、买到真代币的仿品。
items.note_en: 20:56 (TOLL), with 34 posts that day. AI agents now prepare and sign transactions with no person reading each one, and the resulting losses are mostly not exotic and visible before signing: an unlimited approval to a plain wallet or a week-old contract, a transfer to a lookalike address sharing first and last characters, or buying a copy of a real token.

Vitalik：Digital minimalism
items.note: 10:15，4419 赞。博客原文：物理极简之外，现代需要数字极简，让每次使用都是有意识的选择；他没有离开 X 平台，但离开了 X 的界面，大部分时间用 Firefly 同时发到 X、BlueSky、Farcaster 和 Lens，以支持去中心化社交、分散网络效应。
items.note_en: 10:15, with 4,419 likes. In the blog post, he argues that beyond physical minimalism the modern era needs digital minimalism, making each use a conscious choice. He did not leave X the platform but left X the interface, doing most of his posting through Firefly, which posts to X, BlueSky, Farcaster and Lens at once, to support decentralized social media and spread network effects rather than lock them in.

keywords_en: two new consensus clients in a week
summary_en: Vitalik published "Digital minimalism", on using digital technology intentionally; for example, he has not left X the platform but posts through the Firefly multi-client instead. LambdaClass released ethlambda v1.0.0, a Lean Ethereum consensus client, which together with Gattaca's Silver, announced on October 29, makes two new consensus clients in a week. EIP-8141 fixed its transaction nonce check boundary. In the aftermath of the Binance incident, SEAL described how incident response has to be coordinated within minutes.
